description: This file defines the SetupWizardActivity class, which manages the setup wizard UI for the application. It handles page navigation, UI updates, and permissions within the setup process.

classes.name: SetupWizardActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages the setup wizard UI, including page navigation, UI updates, and permissions handling.

classes.name: WizardHandler
classes.description: A static inner class extending Handler to process UI messages for SetupWizardActivity, using WeakReference to avoid memory leaks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up content view, subscribes to settings changes, and initializes the ViewPager adapter.

methods.name: createPagesAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns the adapter for the wizard pages, considering whether language pack is available.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Applies custom edge effect color after activity creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles UI refresh or page scroll when activity resumes.

methods.name: refreshFragmentsUi
methods.description: Notifies the adapter that data set has changed and triggers UI update.

methods.name: scrollToPageRequiresSetup
methods.description: Determines the next page to scroll to based on step completion and initiates scrolling.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes pending scroll messages when activity stops.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of the settings change subscription to prevent leaks.
